newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica to open 70 Illinois branches.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica to open 70 Illinois branches.

text.p: Bank of America FSB, the Midwest retail banking arm of BankAmerica Corp, said Tuesday it plans to open 70 branches in Illinois supermarkets in 1997.
The branches will be opened in American Stores Co's Jewel Food Stores. Bank of America currently has 52 branches in stores and one in its Chicago headquarters, said spokeswoman Lisa Hewitt.
Earlier Tuesday, First Chicago NBD Corp said it will add at least 24 branches in Dominick's Supermarkets Inc stores in 1997, bringing its number of supermarket branches to 45.
First Chicago shares closed up 3/4 at 54-1/8 Tuesday and BankAmerica shares rose 2-1/2 to 101-3/4.
